summary:
## [1.2.1] - 2026-11-02

Release 1.2.1. The audio meters: AtlasIED serves them over UDP only, so the server now keeps that path alive, asks over
UDP when the pushes do not arrive, and every panel says when a processor sends nothing instead of showing silent bars;
the phone's zone tiles carry the live signal. Around it, a second pass over how the screens feel in use: game-day mode
and drag-to-route on the kiosk, a sport picker and sort on the sports guide, recent sources in the TV sheet, Undo on power off, a clock when the kiosk idles, arrow
keys on the plan, taps kept across a reconnect; pinned TVs, swipe actions, an Undo chip and a landscape layout on the
phone; level presets and quick picks on every audio strip, the venue logo and name on virtual controllers and phones;
and for the admin a health card, bulk edit on the TVs page, a preset dry-run, settings history with revert, the venue
as a file, and a high-contrast switch per panel.

### Fixed

- **Audio signal meters.** AtlasIED's third-party guide (ATS006993 rev B) serves meters over **UDP only**, pushed to
  port 3131 on the server, and some firmware leaves them out of a TCP read; the bars then stayed empty with nothing
  saying why. The server now re-sends the meter subscriptions and a UDP keep-alive with every keep-alive (a stream the
  AZM quietly dropped returns within a minute), asks for the values over UDP as well as TCP when nothing arrives (an
  AZM that answers datagrams but whose pushes are blocked fills the bars that way), logs `atmosphere meters silent`
  once with the whole picture, and the Audio pane says "No live meters from … yet" above the zones with the Meters
  line while a connected processor delivers nothing, on every panel. The phone's zone tiles carry the live signal under
  their level bar, which they lacked.

### Added

- **Game day on the kiosk.** A header chip, shown while a box reports what it is on: the TV markers say the matchup
  and how far in it is ("Cowboys at Eagles · 1h12m in") instead of the channel callsign. Now-playing carries the
  programme's start and end from the guide. Per panel.
- **Sports guide picker.** A row over the cards: a chip per sport with its count (a dropdown on a phone) keeps one
  sport, **Sort** keeps the groups or flattens the guide into one list soonest first (live on top) or by channel
  number, **Live** keeps the games on now, and a counter says how many are shown. No more scrolling past fifty
  football games to reach the hockey.
- **Drag a source onto a TV.** Press a source in the sidebar or the chip strip, move, let go over a TV: a chip follows
  the finger, the TV under it is ringed, the drop routes it. A press that does not travel is still a tap; the list
  still scrolls on its own axis.
- **Recent on this TV.** The TV sheet lists the last three sources this panel switched the TV to, one tap each.
- **Undo on power off**, on the selection bar and the phone's Power tab: the same TVs power on again.
- **Dim to a clock after idle** (Settings › Kiosk panels): the kiosk goes dark with a large clock and the venue name;
  the first touch wakes it and goes no further.
- **Arrow keys on the plan.** On a panel with a keyboard the arrows walk from TV to TV, Enter opens one, Space selects.
- **A tap made while reconnecting is kept.** The last route, power, volume or bar tap made while the server is
  unreachable is sent when the link returns, with a toast; the banner says so and of
